title: Tax Strategy Course vs a CPA
h1: Tax strategy course vs hiring a CPA
keyLine: A course teaches the map. A CPA signs the return. Most high earners eventually need both.
description: When a tax class is enough, when you need a CPA, what each can and cannot do, and public example prices. Education, not advice.
query: tax strategy course vs hiring a CPA
answer: A tax strategy course sells lessons. A CPA, a certified public accountant, is a licensed pro who can prepare and sign a return. A course cannot file for you and cannot see your facts unless a person is attached. A CPA without a plan can miss ideas a class would have shown you. If you have a simple W-2 and no rental, a class is optional. If you own a business or a short-term rental, budget for a CPA even if you buy a class.

blocks.heading: When a course is enough
paragraphs: You want vocabulary before a CPA meeting. You will still pay someone to file. You can do homework. You will not treat a module as a filing position.

Cheap examples we could copy: [WealthAbility Live](https://www.wealthability.com/wealthability-live/) at $197 a month. Our [tax program roundup](/blog/best-tax-strategy-programs-w2-earners-over-250k) lists other public prices, including classes that hide the number.

blocks.heading: When you need a CPA or EA this year
paragraphs: You own a rental, a partnership, an S corp, or you sold a business. You got a notice from the IRS. You want someone who can represent you.

A CPA's fee is often not on a homepage. That does not make a $50,000 'done for you' firm the default. Ask for an engagement letter: what they will file, what they will not, and whether planning hours are extra.
If a class says you can skip your CPA, treat that as a warning. Our Blueprint page says you keep your CPA and get a brief to hand them. That is the honest split.

blocks.label: W-2 limit in one line
paragraphs: A course cannot invent a deduction you do not have. After the 401(k) and HSA, most large ideas need a business or a rental. Read [tax strategies for W-2 employees](/tax-strategies/for/w2-employees).

faqs.q: Can a tax course replace my CPA?
faqs.a: No. A course does not sign your return. Some firms sell both class and prep. Ask which hat they are wearing on your file.

faqs.q: Is a cheaper class always worse?
faqs.a: No. A $197 a month series can be enough if you only need ideas. It is worse if you thought they would file.
An EA is a tax pro licensed by the IRS to represent taxpayers. A CPA is licensed by a state. Either can be the right preparer. Ask about real estate or S corp experience if that is your fact pattern.
